a: Transformers use attention mechanisms to model relationships between tokens.
Self-attention lets each token attend to other tokens in the sequence.
BPE/WordPiece tokenizers split text into subword units.
Context window is the maximum tokens a model can consider at once.
Prompt engineering crafts instructions/examples to steer model behavior.
Few-shot provides a few examples in the prompt without weight updates.
Zero-shot means the model attempts a task with no task-specific examples.
Hallucination is fluent but incorrect model output — verify critical facts.
Embed text and search by vector similarity for semantic retrieval.
Chunk long docs into overlapping segments for RAG retrieval quality.
Rerankers reorder retrieved candidates for higher relevance.
LoRA fine-tunes small adapter weights instead of the full model.
